name: PyInstaller macOS Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pyinstaller
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        
    - name: Convert icon to ICNS
      run: |
        # Create temporary directory for icon conversion
        mkdir -p temp_icons
        # Use ImageMagick to convert PNG to ICNS (if available)
        if command -v magick &> /dev/null; then
          magick icon.png temp_icons/app_icon.icns
        elif command -v convert &> /dev/null; then
          convert icon.png temp_icons/app_icon.icns
        else
          # Fallback: create minimal ICNS structure
          echo "Warning: ImageMagick not found, using placeholder icon"
          touch temp_icons/app_icon.icns
        fi
        
    - name: Build macOS application
      run: |
        # Check if spec file exists
        if [ ! -f obi-macos.spec ]; then
          echo "Error: obi-macos.spec file not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        # Build with PyInstaller
        pyinstaller --clean obi-macos.spec || {
          echo "Error: PyInstaller build failed"
          echo "Check the spec file and dependencies"
          exit 1
        }
        
    - name: Create DMG package
      run: |
        # Check if the app was built successfully
        if [ ! -d "dist/obi.app" ]; then
          echo "Error: Application bundle not found in dist/ directory"
          ls -la dist/
          exit 1
        fi
        
        # Create DMG using create-dmg if available
        if command -v create-dmg &> /dev/null; then
          create-dmg \
            --volname "Open Battery Information" \
            --volicon "temp_icons/app_icon.icns" \
            --background "assets/dmg_background.png" \
            --window-pos 200 120 \
            --window-size 800 400 \
            --icon-size 100 \
            --icon "obi.app" 200 190 \
            --hide-extension "obi.app" \
            --app-drop-link 600 185 \
            "obi-macos.dmg" \
            "dist/obi.app"
        else
          echo "Warning: create-dmg not installed, creating basic DMG"
          hdiutil create -srcfolder dist -volname "Open Battery Information" obi-macos.dmg
        fi
        
    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: macos-app
        path: |
          obi-macos.dmg
          dist/obi.app
          
    - name: Validate build
      run: |
        # Verify the DMG was created
        if [ ! -f "obi-macos.dmg" ]; then
          echo "Error: DMG file was not created"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        # Verify app bundle contents
        if [ ! -d "dist/obi.app/Contents/MacOS" ]; then
          echo "Error: App bundle structure is incorrect"
          ls -la dist/
          exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "Build validation successful"
